title: Correct time calculation
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly compute the time from B to C as 0.3 s using the vertical motion equations.

title: Correct initial velocity
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly compute the initial horizontal velocity as 4 m/s using the horizontal motion equations.

title: Displacement angle relationship
description: Important Criteria: The student must correctly apply the projectile motion relationship tan(θ) = (1/2)tan(φ), where θ is the displacement angle and φ is the launch angle, or its equivalent for grazing condition.

title: Geometric displacement components
description: Important Criteria: The student must correctly determine the horizontal and vertical displacements (x = 1.2 m, y = 0.45 m) from the geometry of the semicylinder and the given angle.

title: Independent motion application
description: Important Criteria: The student must correctly apply the equations for horizontal uniform motion and vertical free-fall motion separately.

title: Unit consistency
description: Optional Criteria: The student's solution should maintain consistent units (meters, seconds, m/s) throughout the calculation.

title: Confusing velocity and displacement angles
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student incorrectly assumes the angle at C (53° from horizontal) is the velocity direction instead of the displacement direction, or misapplies the tangent relationship.

title: Sign error in vertical motion
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student uses an incorrect sign in the vertical displacement equation (e.g., using y = (1/2)gt² without accounting for downward direction).
